description: This file contains utility functions and structures for quantization in PyTorch, including conversion between raw uint16 and fp16, quantization parameter selection, weight saturation handling, and bias quantization.

classes.name: TensorQuantizationParams
classes.description: Structure holding quantization parameters: scale, zero_point, and precision.

methods.name: RawUint16ToFp16
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit raw unsigned short to a float in fp16 format.

methods.name: CheckAndSaturate
methods.description: Checks if a value exceeds max or min bounds and saturates it if necessary.

methods.name: ChooseQuantizationParams
methods.description: Selects quantization parameters (scale and zero_point) based on min/max range and options.

methods.name: MakeArgForConv1d
methods.description: Converts 1D convolution arguments to 2D format for compatibility.

methods.name: HandleWeightsSaturation
methods.description: Saturates weight values to FP16 range and warns if out of range.

methods.name: QuantizeBias
methods.description: Quantizes bias tensor, supporting per-channel and per-tensor quantization.
